summary.text: Debra DeSimone is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 18 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Debra DeSimone was born in Malden, Massachusetts, and graduated from Malden High School.
She has served as the tax collector of the Town of Atkinson and the chair of Family Mediation Juvenile Services.
Ballotpedia lists DeSimone's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2008.
